title: Maximum Number of Words Found in Sentences
summary: Given an array of sentences, each a string of words separated by single spaces, find the highest count of words in any single sentence.
statement: Given an array of sentences, each a string of words separated by single spaces, find the highest count of words in any single sentence.
constraints: sentences is nonempty; each sentence has words separated by one space with no leading or trailing spaces.
Count every word in each sentence.
Return the greatest sentence word count.
reference_solution:
def maximum_sentence_words(sentences):
    return max(sentence.count(' ')+1 for sentence in sentences)
hints: With exactly one separator between words, word count equals space count plus one.
Scan sentences and take the maximum of that value.

The separator rule makes the formula exact for every sentence, and max selects the required one.
